The '''HWK-290''' was a light freighter manufactured by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] in an effort to break into a new market for fast, small cargo ships. The production lasted from the decades leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] until being discontinued during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Moldy_Crow_-_X-Wing_Miniatures_Games.jpg|thumb|left|The ''Moldy Crow'']]
Measuring twenty-nine [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, the HWK-290 resembled the head of a large raptor, and required a pilot and co-pilot to operate. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] could accommodate up to six passengers and 150 tons of cargo. The ships were produced without armament; they used speed and maneuverability to escape most situations.

==History==
It was mainly used for delivering small but critical shipment between [[asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[mining/Legends|mines]] and orbital [[Space_station/Legends|stations]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Forces: Jedi Knight]]''</ref>

The most famous of the series was the ''[[Moldy Crow/Legends|Moldy Crow]]'', a heavily modified HWK-290 freighter used by [[Jan Ors]] and [[Kyle Katarn]], the specific unit of which was manufactured in [[9 BBY/Legends|9 BBY]].<ref name="DFS 2" />
